Principal Component Analysis (PCA)
item.description: Luis Serrano’s channel explains machine learning with pictures before equations, and PCA suits the approach: a cloud of points, the direction along which they spread out most, then the next direction at right angles to it, and so on.

item.title: Attention Restoration Theory
item.description: An approach to restoring attention. Environments with stimuli that modestly engage involuntary attention let directed attention recover.

item.title: Brains built for tribes are mismatched with modern technology
item.description: There’s a significant problem in how our brains — shaped first for Paleolithic life, then for Neolithic life in small tribes, and later for organizing around cultural myths into larger social structures — interact with the technology we’re exposed to now.
